acceptance.artifact: recovery actuator plus tests covering re-lease, rerun and resume
acceptance.assertion: An actuator re-leases expired units with a fresh fence, reruns uncommitted units from their immutable dispatch input, resumes checkpointed units at their last checkpoint rather than at zero, and is idempotent under repeated invocation. Cohort a2 measured 0 of 7 in-flight units resuming before the fix.
acceptance.falsified_if: any uncommitted unit requires manual intervention to resume

hypothesis: The recovery scanner detects but never remediates, so the commission's requirement of automatic resume or rerun of uncommitted tasks from immutable input is unmet.
